rounds.text: MPS Ltd exhibits elite capital efficiency, demonstrated by an exceptional return on capital employed of 43.7% and a robust return on equity of 35.2% [E12, E13]. Growth is visibly accelerating across key financial metrics, with compounded sales growth reaching 25% and profit growth hitting 29% over the trailing twelve months [E17, E21]. Operational momentum is further underscored by a stellar quarterly operating margin leap to 44% in June 2026—a 10 percentage point increase over the year-ago quarter—alongside robust cash conversion of 1.09x that fully backs reported profits with Rs 131 crores in free cash flow [E31, E34, E36]. Management has reaffirmed its strategic visibility by guiding for EBITDA to comfortably cross INR 300 crores by FY27, backed by structural client expansion to 841 billed clients in Q1 FY27 and surging demand for trusted AI deployment in high-stakes knowledge workflows [E76, E79, E84]. Conceded: the stock trades at an elevated price-to-book multiple of 11.52x, reflects inconsistent yearly operating margins, and carries a reduced foreign institutional holding of 1.38% [E2, E32, E42].
